title: Store preservation outside a memory-write interval
summary: Tracks exact preservation of non-memory store fields, memory pages, and every byte outside a half-open write interval, with composition and interval weakening.
premises: Initial and final stores and natural byte-interval endpoints
For a write, the entire eight-byte word lies inside the interval
For composition, the two writes use the same interval
For interval weakening, the new interval contains the old interval
result: The final store preserves all fields except its primary memory, keeps the memory-page count, and preserves every byte outside the stated interval.
